name: Sakisaka Kobato
source:
A voice actor attached to the Light Voice Acting Office, She claims to be 21, but she's actually 35 years old.
An excitable woman who puts on an act of being a 'witch girl' and talks in an old-fashioned way.
She puts on a popular radio show called 'Kobato Magic☆'.
